entities.summary: Anthony-John Greer is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the second round, 39th overall, by the Colorado Avalanche in the 2015 NHL entry draft, and won the Stanley Cup with the Panthers in 2025.
